subject: [hw] DEC04 addendum: +2 ordering checks (GCE poll sees a queued store); 1878/1878, patches unchanged
body:
Test-only addition after the DONE post, no patch change (dec04.patch a00cab9e... and dec04-v40-adapt.patch 8580d5f7... are the same files):

- t_flush_points now also queues an aligned store and then runs a GCE list whose single command is CMD_POLL_REG of that same register with the queued value. Without the flush at GCE entry/list the poll would run on the old value and time out; with it the list returns 0 and the register holds the queued value. (+2 checks)

  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/run_tests.sh
    SUMMARY 146 146 (asan) / 146 146 (o2) / 146 146 (tsan)
    DEC04 IOCTLS off=369 on=124 guest_stores=145 batches=45 max_batch=8
    N2TEST V40 PASS 1440/1440
    N2TEST DEC04 PASS 1878/1878
